Plugin.Name: Fejes Mover Monitor
Plugin.Overview: RC1 release candidate. Hungarian, US English and German Mover dashboard and open-file monitor for Unraid 7.x. Observer mode by default. Advanced mode adds opt-in age-filtered native movement for cache/Filmek to the array, skipping young, incomplete, active and open content, with SHA-256 and metadata verification. Selective movement requires the reviewed existing threshold script and user-share torrent paths. Installation never starts movement or creates a schedule. Three scheduled RC1 owner batches moved 24 files (94,199,156,410 bytes; 94.20 GB) with successful executor verification and unchanged client paths/completeness/seed states. The 24-48-hour operating observation is ongoing. Actual peer upload, tracker seed credit, NAS reboot persistence and broad compatibility remain unverified. Release candidate; keep backups. Eligible files use ratio-priority groups, then larger files first within each group. Existing file/byte limits and maintenance guards remain mandatory.
